name: com.velsi.typecraft
description: Text toolkit for TextMeshPro: short markup tags, style and icon libraries, device-aware input prompts, font roles per locale, TMPEffects and Unity Localization integration.

samples.description: Tutorial: a dialogue box with styles, icons, input prompts, TMPEffects, a custom tag and live language/device switching. Учебный сэмпл: диалог со стилями, иконками, подсказками ввода и переключением языка.

Dialogue module: a dialogue box with portraits, choices with Disable/Hide conditions, a flag set by a note in the world, subtitles and a dialogue event that opens a door. Сэмпл диалогов: окно с портретами, выборы с условиями, флаг от записки, субтитры, событие.
Legacy and niche controller prompt sets (Xbox 360, PS3, Vita, Move, Wii, Wii U, Ouya, Stadia, Luna, VR) and controller diagrams.
